Yes, ofcourse you'd like Mississippi Mud from Baskin, or Cotton Candy from Gelato, etc etc., but you've got to try this place.
Also, ambiance? It's always got simple, sweet humans surrounding the shop, with big smiles. Also at night, you'll witness cute families in their joggers, enjoying their desert.
And before I conclude, I've got to say, the humans who work there, they're sweeter than the dessert they serve!

featured_reviews.review_text: This is undoubtedly the best ice cream parlour I've visited till date! It's located in Evershine Nagar Malad. They have varieties of ice cream for reasonable prices. featured_reviews.name: Voracious Blogger
featured_reviews.review_text:
So today I visited Apsara Icecreams - Since 1971 (Malad West)
Everyone knows this well icecream brand and most of you have tried this!
Those who have not tried Apsara Icecream are missing the seasonal as well as common flavours for icecream
The ambiemce was pretty.It had 2 pairs of well maintained sofa and some extra chairs to sit and enjoy the icecreams
The interiors are very well designed and some of the part is in renowation to make it more beautiful
I tried : 1) Guava Masala - Perfectly tasting guava with the pieces of guava inside the icecream with the masala powder sprinkled over it tasted perfectly
2) Belgian Bites - Made up of belgian chocolate having cholate chips and pieces made it tastier then expected
3) Pani Puri icecream - This is my personal favourite as this pani puri icecream tasted like a real pani puri. Over the scoop of icecream there were crush pieces of puri which made it look perfect
4) Blueberry Cheesecake Icecream - This icecream is true heaven for those who love berries. It also had some pieces of berries in it which made it delicious
5) Funky Ferrero and Cookies and cream icecream - I tried trying them in a single cup with half scoop. Cookies and cream tasted like oreo cookies and Funky ferrero had pieces of ferrero chocolate in it
The staff was very quick and gave me some fantastic taste to try!
